item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":0,"rationale":"The President states a general policy and governmental interest but directs no identified official to take a concrete action and creates no legal consequence.","evidence":"It is the policy of the United States to maximize the stewardship of our national wealth for the sole benefit of American citizens."},{"segment_id":"2","code":1,"rationale":"The Treasury and Commerce Secretaries must develop and submit a plan within 90 days; this is an internal planning and reporting assignment, and any legal consequence would require later action.","evidence":"shall develop a plan for the establishment of a sovereign wealth fund"}]}
